title: Rain at Mercer Street
subtitle: Antiquarian jeweler found stabbed in back office during evening storm.

briefing.summary: Jeweler Arthur Pendelton was discovered behind his display safe with fatal puncture wounds. A diamond appraisal shipment worth $420,000 was missing.
briefing.objective: Identify the killer among the store manager, courier, and rival collector by exposing a falsified taxi ride.
requiredSolveConditions: Prove physical presence in the storm

suspects.name: Elena Ward
suspects.profile: Meticulous jeweler facing massive personal debt from failed speculative auctions.
suspects.initialAlibi: Claims she hailed a yellow cab at 20:40 and rode straight to Chelsea.

suspects.name: David Cross
suspects.profile: Former security officer with pristine conduct history.
suspects.initialAlibi: Claims dispatch delayed his van across the bridge until 21:30.

suspects.name: Julian Blackwood
suspects.profile: Wealthy gem collector whose family heirloom was being sold by Pendelton.
suspects.initialAlibi: Dining at Union Square bistro with multiple witnesses.
knownFacts: Sent threatening legal letter 2 days prior

evidence.title: Coroner Report: Arthur Pendelton
evidence.summary: Puncture trauma to thoracic cavity caused by jeweler's diamond scribe between 20:30 and 20:50.
evidence.fullText: Weapon is consistent with a tungsten-carbide gemstone engraving scribe. Death was immediate due to aortic puncture.

evidence.title: Elena Taxi Receipt (Medallion 4B22)
evidence.summary: Printed taxi receipt shows pickup at Mercer St at 20:41 with arrival in Chelsea at 21:05.
evidence.fullText: Receipt printed for Cab #4B22. Fare $24.50 paid in cash. Time stamp: Pickup 20:41, Dropoff 21:05.

evidence.title: TLC GPS Dispatch Log: Medallion 4B22
evidence.summary: Taxi 4B22 was undergoing transmission maintenance in Queens and was never on Mercer Street.
evidence.fullText: Taxi & Limousine Commission official telemetry: Medallion 4B22 was logged in mechanical bay 4 in Long Island City from 16:00 to 23:00. The printed receipt in Elena's possession was blank slip stock from an old machine.

evidence.title: Broken Silk Umbrella in Alley
evidence.summary: Custom monogrammed umbrella 'E.W.' recovered from storm drain behind Mercer St.
evidence.fullText: Monogrammed black umbrella with fractured ribs recovered 15 meters from Mercer rear entrance. Wet silk matches fiber traces on alley pavement.

evidence.title: Default Judgment Notice: Elena Ward
evidence.summary: Court order demanding immediate restitution of $380,000 within 24 hours.
evidence.fullText: State Supreme Court judgment enforcing asset seizure against Elena Ward scheduled for execution at 09:00 next business day.

evidence.title: Engraving Tool Case Audit
evidence.summary: Elena's personalized tungsten diamond scribe missing from bench.
evidence.fullText: Bench examination reveals Elena's assigned engraving tool missing while other staff tools are secured.

evidence.title: Recovered Diamond Pouch
evidence.summary: Pouch of 44 loose diamonds hidden in spare tire well of Elena's sedan.
evidence.fullText: Uncut and certified diamonds matching the Pendelton safe consignment manifest discovered in Elena's registered vehicle.

timeline.title: Arthur Pendelton murdered
timeline.eventDescription: Arthur stabbed with diamond scribe in store back office.

timeline.title: Elena claimed taxi departure
timeline.eventDescription: Elena claims she departed Mercer St in Cab 4B22.

timeline.title: Armored courier van arrives
timeline.eventDescription: David Cross arrives and discovers body.

contradictions.title: Fabricated Taxi Telemetry Alibi
contradictions.explanation: Elena's paper taxi receipt was forged from blank stock: official TLC GPS logs prove Cab 4B22 was in a Long Island City repair shop all night.

contradictions.title: Missing Scribe Matches Wound Dimensions
contradictions.explanation: The coroner's puncture wound matches the unique triangular profile of Elena's missing diamond scribe.

solution.resolutionNarrative: Confronted with an immediate $380,000 court asset seizure, Elena Ward murdered Arthur Pendelton with her engraving scribe, stole the diamond shipment, and fabricated an alibi using a fraudulent taxi receipt.

hints.text: Verify the authenticity of Elena's taxi receipt against official fleet GPS logs.
Cab 4B22 was undergoing repair in Queens. Connect the receipt with the TLC audit to shatter her alibi.
Elena forged the taxi receipt to cover her presence on Mercer St. Broken alibi unlocks the diamond stash in her sedan.
